rules_applied: Rule #1 cancer-only: orphans on benign-only patients = correct downgrade (54 audit-only, ACCEPT default)
Rule LN ENE: lymph node extranodal extension is NOT thyroid-tumor ETE; REJECT from soft_tissue/perineural invasion_types

Rule encapsulated tumor: 'extracapsular extension' on encapsulated tumors (PTC encapsulated, FTUMP, totally encapsulated) means tumor capsule invasion; RECLASS to invasion_type='capsular' + FLIP_TO_PRESENT
Rule vocal cord: vocal cord paralysis / RLN involvement is a different column; RECLASS
Rule mass effect / incidental: deviation/displacement without invasion verb, laryngoceles = REJECT or RECLASS to mass-effect column
